positive.prompt: Write a Rust function that borrows its input instead of cloning it.
Refactor a Rust module to use ownership and typed errors.
Implement an idiomatic Rust API and inspect its Cargo toolchain.

negative.prompt: Plan implementation tasks from this approved specification.
Make this browser dialog accessible to keyboard users.

evals.prompt: In rust-best-practices/, change first_word to borrow &str and return Option<&str> without allocating, preserving first-word and empty-input behavior. Use the Rust specialist alongside the general implementation and testing skills. Add focused tests and run the crate checks. Keep the supported Rust version and existing lint policy; do not copy a lint preset or invent a measured speedup.
evals.expected_output: A scoped Rust result applying specialist guidance within the general workflow, with evidence and honest tool results.
expectations: Uses &str input and Option<&str> output without cloning or allocating the returned word
Covers both a normal multi-word input and empty or whitespace-only input
Runs the fixture crate tests and reports actual results
Keeps the declared Rust version and does not introduce a lint preset or unrelated dependencies
Distinguishes removal of an allocation from an unmeasured runtime performance improvement
